summary_short.zh: Everything-Claude-Code是一个专为AI编程助手设计的性能优化框架，旨在提升如Claude Code等工具在代码生成中的效率和稳定性。它采用研究优先的开发理念，通过技能、直觉、记忆和安全四大核心模块，使AI助手能够更智能地理解上下文并保持一致性。开发者可将其集成到现有工作流中，探索高级智能体功能，优化AI编程体验，或基于其模块化架构构建针对特定编程场景的定制化扩展。

summaries.en: Everything-Claude-Code is an agent harness performance optimization system that enhances AI coding assistants like Claude Code by improving their efficiency and reliability. It employs a research-first approach with specialized modules for skills, instincts, memory, and security, enabling more consistent and context-aware code generation. Developers can integrate it into their workflows to experiment with advanced agent capabilities, optimize existing AI coding tools, or build custom extensions for specific programming tasks.

summary_short.zh: Get-shit-done 是一个基于 JavaScript 的元提示系统，旨在通过结构化 Claude Code 的交互来生成更可靠的 AI 代码。其核心能力是上下文工程——将提示、规范和示例组织成可复用的模板，从而引导 AI 产生一致的输出。开发者可以用它来定义编码标准、根据规范生成样板代码，或为特定领域（如 API 开发或数据处理）构建自定义的提示工作流。该系统通过规范驱动的开发方法，将模糊的需求转化为清晰的指令，适合需要可预测性和可维护性的 AI 辅助编程场景。

Its core innovation is context engineering—organizing prompts, specifications, and examples into reusable templates that guide AI toward consistent outputs. summary_short.zh: Maestro是一款开源端到端测试框架，专为移动和Web应用自动化设计，通过简化配置和脚本编写降低测试门槛。其核心创新在于采用基于YAML的声明式语法，允许将用户操作定义为简单动作序列，使测试用例更易读写和维护。开发者可快速为Android、iOS和Web平台编写测试，集成到持续交付流程中，并利用可视化录制功能捕捉真实交互进行自动化验证，适合需要高效回归测试和跨平台兼容性检查的团队。

summaries.en: Maestro is an open-source end-to-end testing framework that simplifies mobile and web app automation by eliminating complex setup and scripting. Its key innovation is a YAML-based declarative syntax that allows testers to define user flows as simple sequences of actions, making tests more readable and maintainable than traditional code-heavy approaches. Developers can quickly write tests for Android, iOS, and web platforms, integrate them into CI/CD pipelines, and use its visual test recorder to capture real user interactions for automated validation.

summary_short.zh: Arnis 是一款开源工具，能够将真实世界的地理数据转换为高度精细的《我的世界》游戏地图，实现数字世界与现实地点的无缝对接。它通过调用 OpenStreetMap 和 Overpass API 提取地图信息，并利用 Rust 语言的高效性能将道路、建筑等地物精准转化为游戏方块。用户可基于其模块化设计自定义地形生成规则，用于创建教育可视化项目、开发定制游戏场景，或探索程序化世界生成的技术思路。

summaries.en: Arnis is an open-source tool that transforms real-world geographic data into detailed Minecraft worlds, bridging digital recreation with actual locations. It leverages OpenStreetMap and Overpass API to extract and convert map features into Minecraft blocks with impressive accuracy. Developers can use its Rust-based architecture to customize terrain generation, experiment with procedural world-building, or integrate it into educational projects that visualize real places in a game environment.

summary_short.zh: OpenDataLoader-PDF 是一款基于 Java 的开源 PDF 解析工具，可将复杂 PDF 文档转换为 JSON、HTML 等结构化、AI 可读的数据格式。它结合 OCR 识别与边界框检测技术，在准确提取文本的同时保留文档布局和可访问性元素，输出结果既适合机器处理也便于人工理解。该工具可集成至数据预处理流程，自动化支持信息检索、合规检查或为 AI 模型提供训练数据，适用于需高效文档解析的研究与应用场景。

summaries.en: OpenDataLoader-PDF is a Java-based PDF parser that transforms complex documents into structured, AI-ready data formats like JSON and HTML, addressing the challenge of extracting meaningful information from PDFs for machine learning applications. Its technical strength lies in combining OCR recognition with bounding-box detection to preserve document layout and accessibility features, making parsed content both machine-readable and human-friendly. Developers can integrate it into data pipelines to automate document processing for tasks like information retrieval, accessibility compliance, or training custom AI models on textual data.
